stories.title: North Wales Police report high number of 999 calls after wildfire emergency alert
stories.summary: North Wales Police said they were receiving a high number of 999 calls after an emergency alert warning of a very high wildfire risk was sent to phones across England and Wales on Friday evening. stories.title: Disposable barbecues temporarily banned from sale in Flintshire shops
stories.summary: Shops in Flintshire that keep selling disposable barbecues during the drought will be in breach of product safety law, and can be prosecuted. stories.title: Delays building on the A550 after collision near Two Mills traffic lights
stories.summary: The A550 Welsh Road is closed in both directions following a road traffic collision between the Two Mills traffic lights and Woodbank Lane. stories.title: Home Office pauses Gronant asylum housing plan after MP meeting
stories.summary: The Home Office says it is listening to local concerns to reduce the impact of asylum housing on communities like Gronant following strong local opposition.
